name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Build a 5-qubit GHZ circuit in pytket, e
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Build a 5-qubit GHZ circuit in pytket, export it to OpenQASM 2 with circuit_to_qasm_str, then re-import it and check the round trip preserves the statevector. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
